thread:
maria (AE): quick heads-up — Hightower legal just pushed back on two MSA clauses and wants PO + invoice routing confirmed before exec signs. they uploaded redlines.
katie (Legal): which clauses? can you paste the excerpts or the doc link? we need to check indemnity + data subproc.
josh (SE): FYI their POC is on dedicated infra, asking about KMS/HSM for keys and whether logs will be retained outside EU. also asking cost for additional reserved capacity during POC.
oliver (Procurement): @maria which remit-to + billing contact do they require? also do they insist on PO number on invoice or net terms? we can usually do Net30 with PO.
maria (AE): they want invoice to: Hightower Inc., AP department, billing@hightower.com. PO required on invoice. Exec wants countersign same day as PO is in. they attached: https://files.hightower/redlines-msadpa.pdf
katie (Legal): high priority: they redlined section 9 (indemnity) to broaden to their affiliates and removed Redwood limitation. also added SCCs reference in DPA and asked for Data Processing Addendum with EU SCCs. i'll add comments. @sam can you start a request to Legal Ops for SCCs review?
sam (Sales Ops): on it — starting routing flow. do we have preferred signer sequence? we can do: AE prepares order form -> customer signs -> finance receives PO -> Redwood countersign. do we want to queue expedited countersign if PO received?
josh (SE): they also want clarity on SLA: 99.9% uptime for Dedicated during POC, and an uptime credit formula. our standard is 99.5 for Dedicated evals. we should confirm if POC can have a temporary SLA override or a written exception.
oliver (Procurement): if they require 99.9 we need to quantify; ops will need to set dedicated pool reservation or charge for premium. estimate +30% to monthly commit for that window.
maria (AE): proposed plan: 1) legal to propose compromise language on indemnity and SCCs (katie) 2) sales ops to prepare order form template w/ PO field and billing contact (sam) 3) finance/proc to confirm upgraded SLA pricing (oliver) 4) SE to answer KMS/HSM and logs/data locality Qs (josh). who can turn around today?
katie (Legal): i can draft redline comments by EOD but need point-by-point from them on why indemnity was broadened.
josh (SE): i'll send a short tech note re: KMS options + EU logging today. snippet:
```
- Private deployment: customer-managed KMS (BYOK) via HSM/KMS supported
- Hosted: we offer envelope encryption; keys managed by Redwood unless customer requests Dedicated KMS (enterprise add-on)
- Logs: can be routed to customer VPC for Private deployment; hosted exports limited and covered by DPA
```
oliver (Procurement): i'll run numbers for 99.9 SLA premium and post here.
sam (Sales Ops): creating DocuSign envelope template now. adding reviewer step for Legal before send. @docu-sign-bot can you create envelope draft for Hightower with PO field and billing reminders?
docu-sign-bot: draft created: envelope HGT-PO-1923456789. reviewers: katie (Legal), maria (AE), oliver (Procurement).
maria (AE): perfect — I'll ping the customer to accept redline call today at 3pm PT and request they return PO same day if we agree.
katie (Legal): ok i'll review envelope and drop inline comments. if they insist on SCCs we need Legal Ops signoff, might add 24-48h.
oliver (Procurement): noted. if PO + countersign slips beyond EOD we escalate to exec for approval.
maria (AE): thanks team. i'll update thread after the 3pm call. :crossed_fingers:
